en_us.item.drone.patrol.name: Transport Drone
en_us.item.drone.patrol.desc: Follows a route of waypoints$Tries to load/unload every time it reaches a drone crate$Right click on top of a drone crate to place.
en_us.item.drone.patrol_chunkloading.name: Chunkloading Transport Drone
en_us.item.drone.patrol_chunkloading.desc: Follows a route of waypoints$Tries to load/unload every time it reaches a drone crate$Right click on top of a drone crate to place.$Loads chunks!
en_us.item.drone.patrol_express.name: Express Transport Drone
en_us.item.drone.patrol_express.desc: Follows a route of waypoints$Tries to load/unload every time it reaches a drone crate$Right click on top of a drone crate to place.
en_us.item.drone.patrol_express_chunkloading.d: Follows a route of waypoints$Tries to load/unload every time it reaches a drone crate$Right click on top of a drone crate to place.$Loads chunks!
en_us.item.drone.request.name: Logistics Drone
en_us.item.drone.request.desc: Used by logistics drone docks to spawn logistics drones$Drones will follow logistics drone waypoints$After completing a request, the drone will return to the dock.
en_us.item.drone_linker.name: Transport Drone Linker
en_us.tile.drone_crate.name: Transport Drone Crate
en_us.tile.drone_crate.desc: Loading and unloading point for transport drones.$Acts as a waypoint, has to be linked with the drone linker.$Drones must approach from a high angle, or they will get stuck.
en_us.tile.drone_waypoint.name: Transport Drone Waypoint
en_us.tile.drone_waypoint.desc: Waypoint for transport drones$Use a transport drone linker to set the path$Click on each waypoint and crate in sequence to create the path,$then shift-click to clear the saved position$Right-click or shift-click the waypoint to change the waypoint's offset

zh_cn.item.drone_linker.name: 运输无人机链接器
